echo "=== frontend dev server (3002) ==="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "3002/app/: %{http_code}\n" -m 5 http://localhost:3002/app/
echo "=== public entry (3000 via oauth2-proxy) ==="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "3000/app/: %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -m 5 http://localhost:3000/app/
echo "=== follow to keycloak login ==="; curl -sSL -o /dev/null -w "final: %{url_effective} code=%{http_code}\n" -m 10 http://localhost:3000/app/
echo "=== keycloak realm ==="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "keycloak 9090: %{http_code}\n" -m 5 http://localhost:9090/realms/local
echo "=== temporal ui ==="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "8233: %{http_code}\n" -m 5 http://localhost:8233/
echo "=== minio console ==="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "9001: %{http_code}\n" -m 5 http://localhost:9001/
echo "=== qdrant ==="; curl -sS -m 5 http://localhost:6333/ | head -c 120; echo
echo "=== keycloak login page has our realm? ==="; curl -sS -m 10 "http://localhost:9090/realms/local/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=local-client&redirect_uri=http://localhost:3000/oauth2/callback&response_type=code&scope=openid" | grep -oE "<title>[^<]*" | head -2
